title: BigP3BCI Study I — 9x8 checkerboard/performance-based (13 healthy subjects)
description: BigP3BCI Study I is a derivative EEG dataset comprising recordings from 13 healthy subjects performing a P300-based brain-computer interface speller task using a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus paradigm. The dataset contains 16-channel EEG data sampled at 256 Hz with target and non-target event classifications, designed for evaluating P300 detection algorithms and BCI performance metrics within a laboratory setting.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz with 60 Hz line frequency filtering. Subjects performed a single session of a P300 speller task using a 9x8 checkerboard visual stimulus paradigm with online feedback. Trial intervals were defined from 0 to 1.0 seconds post-stimulus.
